summary: Steep, narrow residential lane with homes close all round and no room to pull off.
reasons: Lane too narrow to pull clear

best_section.where: Top of Murray Street at the bend, west kerb

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 14-20 m from the top section and homes on both sides; none are secluded.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane between fences and trees with no verge or pull-off wide enough for a van to clear the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end style residential street, low traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars or camping convention visible on the narrow stretch; a few cars park at the wider bend.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the lower half; the top is open to the sky with partial shade from the west.
